result:
Round 182 (M3, a 4 px gap between library rows) **passes**. A introduced no bugs. `browserVerified` and `realVerified` are both true. All browser checks ran in Playwright Chromium at 1440×900 and 1280×720, each in a new anonymous context. I compared against a clean copy of HEAD `f1782f8` on port 5174. Its resting screenshots match C round 181's exactly (0 px different), so the baseline is sound.

- **Code and scope:**
  - The targeted tests pass, 329/329.
  - Only the 3 permitted files changed, plus the new doc 150; nothing protected changed.
  - The source change is one class token, `space-y-1`, on the listbox.
  - Each of A's four deliberate breakages (m304–m307) made only the new LGS1 test fail, and m306 and m307 failed on the per-row checks as required.
- **Spacing:** all 8 gaps measure exactly 4.00 px at both sizes. Row heights and the first row's position are unchanged from HEAD, and row *n* is exactly 4·*n* px lower. Every row except the last has a 4px bottom margin; the last has none.
- **Nothing else moved:** every panel box is identical to HEAD, and the screenshot diff shows changed pixels only inside the list.
- **Scrolling:** the list's total height is 669 px (HEAD 637). At the end of the list, the last row sits 4.25 px above the bottom. ArrowDown selects each row in turn and the eighth press reaches the ninth row.
- **Behaviour:** click, double-click, Enter and drag onto the Music lane each work, and each added exactly one clip, which Undo removed. Preview shows "Playing" and produced real audio output (peak 0.374). A click in the new gap does nothing, which is the expected cost B accepted. At the same spot on HEAD the click landed on a row.
- **Play button:** unchanged at 32×32 with the title "Play (Space)".
- **Sign-in protection:** `/studio-lab` opens with no stored login and no cookies. `/studio/middle-east` shows "Sign in required" with no workspace. The token request returns 401.
- **Network and errors:** no forbidden hosts, login headers, hydration messages or page errors in the four main runs and the sign-in check. The two small focus checks recorded page errors only (none).

Blocked: the fake-Bearer 403 check, because the backend isn't available in the cloud. The full suite, build and verify rows belong to the root gate and are not claimed.

For B — two older issues show up in this round, and two harness runs were repeated:
- **Double focus ring (part of the deferred C-R169-N1 finding):** when a library row gets keyboard focus, a global focus outline in `app/styles/app.css` (line 379) draws a second ring 4 px outside the row. HEAD looks the same. The task's wording "no taller rectangle" is therefore not literally met. I passed it as pre-existing, the same way round 181 handled the button's press shrink. B should reword that check or add library rows to C-R169-N1.
- **C-R182-N1 (info):** at 1440, the sixth ArrowDown press leaves the row 0.25 px past the list's bottom edge because the scroll position is rounded to a whole pixel. HEAD does exactly the same, and it isn't visible.
- **Discarded runs:** one first cold load crashed while vite rebuilt its dependency cache, a known environment problem, so I discarded it and ran it once more. The first HEAD focus check also timed out on a cold load and was run once more.

No app source was edited and nothing was committed. The HEAD copy and its server are removed.

Files are in /home/runner/czaba-project/tmp/studio-real-loop:
- c-round-182.md
- c-round-182.json
- c-round-182/ (outputs, screenshots and scripts)
